title: fast-vollib instrument record
description: A single fast-vollib instrument, serialized. Records are discriminated by 'instrument_type' and versioned by 'schema_version'. Objects are closed: an unknown field is an error, not ignored input. Generated from the same field table the runtime codec uses; do not edit by hand. Experimental until explicitly declared stable.

asian_option.title: AsianOption
asian_option.description: Option on an average of the underlier over the contract's life.

schema_version.description: Version of the instrument record format.

instrument_id.description: Caller-chosen identity for the record. No valuation meaning.

underlier.description: Reference to the underlier this contract is written on.

option_type.description: Call or put. The short 'c'/'p' flags are not wire format.

strike.description: Strike price under a fixed strike convention; null under a floating one, where a level read off the path plays the strike's role.

averaging_method.description: Whether the average is arithmetic or geometric.

strike_convention.description: Whether the strike is agreed at inception or read off the path.

maturity.description: Time to maturity as a year fraction from valuation. Strictly positive: a path-dependent payoff needs a path.

settlement.description: How the contract settles at maturity.

notional.description: Contract multiplier. Non-zero and finite; negative denotes a short position.
